steps.name: Shiina's message
steps.objective: Go to [Shiina] in the “Magic Academy Lobby”.

steps.name: Magic academy revisited
steps.objective: Receive guidance from [Shiina] in the “Magic Academy Lobby” and enter the “Academy Director’s Office.” Then report the quest to [Zephyros].

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Adventurer! Welcome!
(As soon as Shiina sees %s's appearance, she rushes to hug her with a flushed look.)

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: I missed you so much!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shiina is still the same. nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: How have you been? I heard it through rumors, but I still want to hear it in person.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Many things happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly talk about what happened during the time I did not meet Shiina.)

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Wow… .

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: You've been through a lot during this time. Solve it all again. As expected, Adventurer. You are amazing.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: I wanted to see you again, and I'm so glad we were able to meet each other like this. You met my sister a lot... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Somehow, I ended up being indebted to Dana a lot.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Oh, that's right.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: It's none other than Chairman Zephyros's request, so I'm giving you a message on his behalf.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Seeing that you arrived right away, I guess my message arrived properly. It was my first time using wind magic that far, so I was a little nervous.
(Shiina looks happy.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Where are Mr. Chloris and Zephyrus?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: The two of you are in the academy director's office together. What you're talking about is getting longer.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: That's the academy principal's office. I will guide you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay, Shiina. It's right in front of you. But why is it so noisy?
(The door shakes as if an intense conversation is going on inside the academy director's office. Shiina makes an embarrassed expression and then sighs.)

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Phew, the sisters are here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sisters? ah… .

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: They're really nice girls, but they're a bit off when you start talking to them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All brothers and sisters are like that.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Now that Adventurer is here, I hope the sisters will stop... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there any good way?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Please wait a moment.
(Shiina seems to have made up her mind and opens the door to the academy director's office slightly and tries her own method.)

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Sisters, if you don’t do it in moderation, you will go to your great-aunt!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you a great-aunt?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Yes, he is a really cool person. Oh, you can go in now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Shiina. Would you like to go in together?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: No. are you okay. Please tell my sisters that I will be waiting here. I don't really want to see my sisters right now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will, Shiina. See you later.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Yes~. Then let's talk.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But does that method work? Hmm….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is %s. Can I come in?

lines.speaker: 클로리스의 목소리
lines.text: Yes, Mr. %s, please come in.
(This is the first visit to the academy principal's office since the school festival. Zephyros recognizes Adventurer first and greets him.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Welcome.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: %s, welcome. I was already waiting. Come to think of it, this is your first time in the academy principal’s office, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I had to deal with Chloris, who was fused with Windy Seed at the school festival... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Ahhh, forget about that.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Would you please forget about the winged grandfather clock? The students think they just saw something in vain. So I only saw %s... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Right? Just pretend %s didn't see it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No way, Mr. Chloris… . You weren't planning on doing anything to me, were you?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Oh, no way… .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Chloe, it's all on your face.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I still think of that image every night and it kills me.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: It will get better with time. But those two don't look good... .
(Shadows are cast on Dayna and Kaina's faces, perhaps because of what Shiina said just now.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Sister, Shiina said she was going to visit her great-aunt... ?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: It's probably just something I tried... . Shiina knew where her great-aunt was... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I guess so?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: You said you were contacting me, but if Shiina even said something like that... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: … Oh, I don't even want to imagine it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who is this great-aunt that makes you two tremble like that?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I heard it from Shiina. He's the only trustworthy relative left.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: He lives far away and is busy, so he hasn't been able to see him often since he was young.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm, I see. By the way, are you two okay now?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Ah, Mr. %s… . Are you here?
(Dana comes to her senses and greets Adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: You are here.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I was sorry last time.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Last time, I wasn't in a good mood so I couldn't tell you I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I'm sorry for calling someone and embarrassing you about my sister. I apologize. This isn't because of you. Because it’s entirely my problem… .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Sorry, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine. You two, don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I didn't know that His Majesty would come to visit.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I have an important story to tell.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Maybe Yeji… .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Not this time.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: It wouldn't be normal if His Majesty spoke directly... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Both of these are important stories. Hmm… .

steps.name: important story
steps.objective: Use the conversation menu to hear about <What happened 10 years ago> from [Kaina] and <The reason for focusing on the Office of Magic> from [Zephyros]. Then, report the quest to [Chloris] in the “Academy Director’s Office.”

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: You can listen to the story you want to hear first, from me and the chairman.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Do as your Majesty says, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (…Then which story should we hear first?)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I would like to thank you again. Thank you for clearing up the witchcraft that occurred on Aie Island and Riftrasir.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, no. your majesty.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Despite %s's performance, all is not over. Aaron… . I learned the purpose of Aaron’s movement.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You told me before that you were looking for a witch... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: A long time ago, a war broke out in Freios over supremacy. Many forces rose, fell, and disappeared.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: As the kingdom of Sylvaria gained hegemony, Queen Shiina, who was the king at the time, became the first emperor.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: You already know this, right? %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not in detail, but to some extent.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Then I will continue the story.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Humans have long since eliminated beings that cause harm. Among them, there were fierce animals, demonic beasts from the demon world, demons, and witches.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: At that time, the council decided to focus on witches and caught them. Among them, there was a witch who was doing really bad things... , there were also witches who weren't.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Are there witches who don't do bad things?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Yeah. There were also witches who stayed in hiding, doing nothing.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Among those caught as witches, there were also just humans.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: They were people who opposed the nobles who held power in parliament. The opposition was naturally accused of being witches, and for worshiping witches... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Everyone must be dead... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Since then, witches have rarely appeared. Because if you show up, you face the fate of being killed by someone.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: When the council began looking for such a witch, they used the same name as then. as soon as… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: witch hunt... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not like I'm just going to catch them and kill them... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: They want something from the witch. Like witches killing each other and taking their powers.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: And what about Barbatos?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: He showed up again and made fun of me by bringing up something that happened 10 years ago. And just like that time, we also found evidence of contact with a witch.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: It must have been a coincidence that Barbatos met us at that time.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: That's a coincidence... . Sister, no way… .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: What you think is right.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Because my foresight had nothing to do with Barbatos.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Phew… .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Dana, I'm going to tell %s our story from 10 years ago. It'll be okay.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: %s is okay. I can believe it and say it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty, Mr. Dana... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: This is going to be a bit of a long story.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: 15 years ago, when Shiina was two years old, her mother passed away from a chronic illness.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: At this time, the nobles in the National Assembly recommended a daughter from each family, saying that for the sake of the stability of the country, the position of a new empress could not be left empty.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It's a recommendation, but it forces you to have a son with a partner chosen by the council and carry on the line of succession.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Unlike previous emperors, my father secretly went out when he was a prince and had a secret relationship, and brought my mother with me as if declaring war, saying, “I want to marry this person.”

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: He’s like a father… .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: My mother was the only daughter of a fallen nobleman. There was no way the nobles of the Parliament, who had wealth, honor, and power, would look kindly on the daughter of a fallen family.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Our sisters, who were born to mothers from such families, were also not viewed favorably.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Even though he is clearly a member of the imperial family... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: My father did not accept the council's proposal, saying it would be a shame for both my mother and us.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: He appointed a new empress so that his daughters could dream of a better future rather than his son, who could never be born.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: And 10 years ago… , my father was murdered. To Barbatos… .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: That day, a nobleman led mercenaries and attacked the imperial castle. They say that an unqualified person should not ascend to the throne... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: My precognitive abilities tied up the mercenaries, and the Scarred Knights of the Red Moon eliminated them all. Although the number was a bit small to call it a rebellion... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: My father knew about my abilities, but he didn't show them. You only used my precognitive abilities in the future to eliminate the rebels.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Among the futures I saw was my father's death... . You told me never to tell Dana. I also have a youngest child, so I'm afraid he might get agitated... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Barbatos appeared and tried to take Shiina away. A witch appeared before and said that Shiina must be taken to a dark place.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Black place?)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: We rescued Shiina with the help of the Scars of the Moon members that Argent belonged to... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Anyway, the witch retreated as if nothing had happened, saying she would find another way. We lost our minds and didn't remember what happened for a moment... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: The witch's name is... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard it from Shiina. It was Daphne.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: That's right. Daphne… .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Are you the witch you met at the cathedral this time?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Like that witch, Barbatos also tried to take Shiina away, saying she would be sacrificed.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: To witches, to demons… . My father tried to protect Shiina from Barbatos. However, except that my father was an emperor, he was also an ordinary human being.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Instead of protecting my brother, we failed to protect our father. I was weak and foolish... . My father said it was okay, but… .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Dana, don’t be too hard on yourself… .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: After her father fell, Barbatos seemed to have changed his mind and put Shiina down.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: And… , I walked away and said we would meet again someday.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: At that time, Barbatos seemed to feel something. As if there is something nearby that needs to be avoided... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: … It would have been nice if she had seen something back then, but nothing like that happened... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Few nobles in the council know that Barbatos has appeared. That's what Congress said... . ah… . I remembered an unpleasant memory... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Phew… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I understand you, but I don't know if it was the best choice at the time... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Dana… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Should we stop talking about this now?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Yeah... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: This is what happened to us 10 years ago.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Daphne and Barbatos targeted Shiina. And what was the point of finding another way?)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Chloe and I will always be grateful to you. The same goes for the last school festival and this incident in the Crystal Moon Forest... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Thank you so much, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. What am I… .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: And I'm sorry. I feel like I'm dragging you into this... . As you may already know, the shadow of the empire is deep and wide.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shadow… .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: If I had passed without knowing, I would have committed a sin without knowing. But, if you knew, everyone would have made the same choice as me.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: My father was a wizard, but he asked me to call him a magic researcher.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: He originally planned to bury his bones at the Wise Man's Tower, but he came out and continued his own research.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: The Ministry of Magic's reputation among wizards at the time was not very good. Because they had a monopoly on new talent, and were intertwined with the Congress, calling themselves servants of power.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: My father didn't like handling the work requested by the Magic Agency, but he had no choice but to do it until the end because he couldn't afford it.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Maybe 10 years ago... , A few days before His Majesty passed away... . I received a call that my father had passed away due to a runaway of magical power after he touched an unauthorized magic tool in the Magic Agency's warehouse... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: There's no way a talented person like my father would make such a mistake... . Phew… .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: When Notos and I were the only family left and we were in despair, we received a lot of help.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I went to boarding school in the capital, was noticed by a wizard, and was able to work at the Magic Agency.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: It was the best choice any beginner wizard could wish for.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: That was possible because I knew nothing. But, once I found out, I couldn’t do anything.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth is going on... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: My father's death was an accident. But, it might not have happened. Because it was created by the shadow of the Magic Agency... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: My father just needed the materials he had in the warehouse. You didn't know that the magic golem sleeping in the warehouse would wake up... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Magic Golem… . no way… .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Notos and I saw a piece of my father's bloody cloak hanging on a magic golem in the warehouse... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: While Notos decided that he could no longer be at the Magic Agency and went to protest, I looked for information related to the magic golem.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: However, I was threatened and silenced.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: If my brother wants to dig deeper into this, I will kill Chloe and everyone else around him.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: So I had to make a decision in that short amount of time. To become a hostage myself.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: So when Notos came back, we fought for ridiculous reasons. My father's death was just an accident, so why should I leave here? .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: That's how Notos was kicked out of the Magic Agency. Next is Chloe… , I ran away from Chloe like I was diving... . Still, I had to make sure I did it.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Chloe can't stay at the Magic Agency either... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Finally, after everyone had left, I decided to do what I had in mind. I decided to approach the shadow of the Magic Agency. So, I spent five years as a dog at the Ministry of Magic.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I was able to figure it out to some extent. The shadow I gained by turning my back on everyone... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Thank you for your hard work.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Chloe, I'm fine, so don't make that face.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Still… . Oh, how do you tell Notos?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I'll take care of that. Thank you for your concern.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Are you two okay now...?)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: %s, listen carefully. I don't have time anymore. Plus, there will be more work to do.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Do you remember the place where Degos was stopped a few years ago?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. Flower garden… .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Hwawon almost became a gateway to the demon world, but you were able to prevent it thanks to your actions. However, several places other than the flower garden that could be such a door were discovered.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: From what I understand, there were places like Rosengarten and Vanitas that you went to.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Zephyrus, do you know that place too? How much does the Magic Agency know?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I just read the information they created, but I'm not sure how they figured it out.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Anyway, something big happened as that door kept appearing and disappearing.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: The magical vortex between the western and eastern Freios, including the empty sea, began to calm down little by little. You can see that the magical power is weakening.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Now Freios is up in the sky of another continent.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait a minute… . This is it. When the flow of magical energy surrounding the continent weakens, Freios is now... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: It's okay to imagine. fall.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: The moment the magical power disappears from the Continent of Freios, which was split into several pieces and rose into the sky, it will fall into this sea of stars and another continent.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … oh my god… .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: High-ranking wizards were feeling this phenomenon. In particular, the executives of the Magic Agency must have felt strongly about it, but they did nothing.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Instead, I focused a lot of my attention on other things.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: In order to operate the ancient magic golem, people's souls and emotions were experimented with in various ways.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Moreover, they also created the ancient Creed beastman who freely controlled such magic golems. I don't know what happened inside that lab, but... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Now the beastman killed the wizard and escaped, taking the ancient magic golem with him. The person who killed my father... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Noname and Lyricaria?)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: All of that is being done under the leadership of Congress. I'm quiet when it comes to things related to doors, but I'm active when it comes to things like that.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: And it seems like there are more people involved in this than just members of Congress. Because it was witches and demons who allowed the beastman to go outside.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: It's complicated, right? I couldn't help it. This is all the facts I can confirm. I need more information... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Both His Majesty and Dana said they would help, so it will be okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what happens to Zephyrus? If you know something like the secrets of the Magic Agency... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: They all know it too. But, it might be useful to leave me alone. I don't know what it is yet.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: The humans of the Magic Agency, they have already given up on being humans... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … thank you. It must have been a difficult story... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: No… . Thanks for listening to my story.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: What is the purpose of the demon called Barbatos that appears in His Majesty’s words?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos wants to become the master of this world, a god.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: God? They're demons, but they're gods?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Chloris briefly about meeting Barbatos in Sanctuary.)
(Kaina mutters in a low voice while listening to %s's story.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Somehow... . I've never really seen the prophecy that Barbatos appeared in... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Sister?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I'm talking to myself. don't mind.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Oh, I forgot something while talking. parliament… .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I'm telling you this because I trust you, so please keep this story quiet so it doesn't get told anywhere else.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Argent, together with the knights, detained a noble belonging to the council. I captured the circumstances of the encounter with the demons.

steps.name: hello and hello
steps.objective: Talk to [Chloris] in the “Academy Director’s Office” and report the quest to [Arke] in “Pneuma”.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Oh my... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I can't believe something like that happened... .
(When people are shocked and unable to continue talking, the grandfather clock in the center of the school lobby rings on the hour.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Ah, it's already so time... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Oh, I see.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: By the way, sister. Is it okay to leave like this?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I already said that I would be taking the day off today due to personal reasons, so I left behind a doll that resembled me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty… ?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Hmm, hmm… .
(Kaina smiles brightly as if nothing has happened.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Just kidding. I left after speaking properly.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: My sister's jokes aren't funny. There's an atmosphere where everyone doesn't believe it.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Dana.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: It's been a while, so let's eat together.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Now? There's a lot of work to do right now... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: It's Shiina's wish.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Okay. It's Shiina's wish... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Thanks, Dana. Ah, %s… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty? If you have anything to say to me... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Oh, no. I'll contact you later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will be waiting.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: We will contact Zephyros when the time comes.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Yes, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: The Council and the Ministry of Magic executives will already know how Zephyrus was feeling and what he did.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: If a dangerous moment comes, I will let you know first. Because I have prepared a place for you to stay in Luria.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I am very sorry, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Hehe, thank you anyway, Zephyrus. Thanks to you, I have made up my mind.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Please excuse me. Come on, Dana.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Are you outside, Shiina?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Yes, sister! I'm hungry. How long has it been since we all ate together like this?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: That's right. How soon will it be?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I'm sorry... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: You're not suddenly saying sorry. Okay, Dana?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Okay… .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Okay, let's go.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Academy director, chairman. I will come back after eating with the girls. Are you giving me permission to go out?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Please come back.
(As the three sisters leave, the once noisy academy principal's office becomes quiet.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It was a crazy day... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: What are you going to do now?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: To meet with Notos and talk. … I don't expect it to be easy for you to understand, but still... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Notos will understand everything.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Thank you… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It seems like things have gone back to normal between the two... What should I do now...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But, I have a strange feeling. As if something is going to happen...)
(At that moment, as the surrounding air changed, a small white cloud-like thing appeared in front of my eyes and smiled brightly.)
(And then a familiar voice is heard among them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Arke? Then is this Aerura?)

lines.speaker: 아르케의 목소리
lines.text: (%s, this is Arke. Since I sent Aerura, you must be hearing my voice, right?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What's going on?)

lines.speaker: 아르케의 목소리
lines.text: (I think you should come to Pneuma. I found a door. It leads to ▒▒▒▒.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Arke, I can't hear the place name clearly.)

lines.speaker: 아르케의 목소리
lines.text: (Ah… I guess it’s not yet. I guess they don’t allow me to hear their name.

lines.speaker: 아르케의 목소리
lines.text: (…If you say hello to the person there, Aerura will bring %s to Pneuma.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Really?)
(Zephyros and Chloris look at %s muttering into the air and nod as if they understand something.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: %s… , I was talking to a spirit.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's a cloud. It looks cute.
(Aerura smiles at Chloris' words and waves a musical note above her head.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, you were watching. uh? Can you two see this Aerura?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Aerura… They say so.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Yes, I can see it.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: But why did we talk for so long?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There is a place that wants me to come.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: (It wouldn't be normal if a spirit asked to visit...)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: As expected, %s is very popular. I'm sure you're tired. Are you okay? It hasn't been long since you arrived from Riftrasir.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine. Mr. Chloris. Now, let me say hello here.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: If you say it's okay, then I won't worry.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Take care, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, you two. See you later.

steps.name: Beyond the suspicious door
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Arche] in 「Pneuma」, and follow [Arche] to a place connected to 「Pneuma」 and another location. 
2. After talking with Iris in the “Oracle’s Room,” report the quest to [Irfan] at the destination.

lines.text: (Pneuma was found again following Aerura, and the once energetic spirits are moving slower than usual.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Something is strange...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aerura? I was having fun just a moment ago... . what?
(Aerura, who brought Adventurer from outside, also slows down as she enters Pneuma.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: %s, are you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay, Arche?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I'm fine, but I'm having a bit of a problem with the spirits. But don't worry too much. It's just a little bit slower.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it about Chronos and Kairos?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: That's not it either. I'll be back soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche, what happened? Tell me.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Actually, it's not even a secret... . Suddenly, a door appeared in the pneuma.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The door?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: This is the first time something like this has happened since I came to Pneuma.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know where you are going?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Since I couldn't leave Pneuma, I stood in front of the door and several spirits wanted to go, but I couldn't go in.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: A space that even Kronos and Kairos cannot approach... . Even the spirit of Pneuma was blocked, meaning it was not allowed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Permission… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A being higher than spirits….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (God…?)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I'm contacting Iris and %s because I feel like I need to let them know. First of all, I will continue to look into it, so if I find anything suspicious, I will let you know right away.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Adventurer?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry. Arche… . Can you tell me where that door is?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: The door? Please follow me.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Here it is. It looks like an ordinary road, but there is an invisible wall built in front of it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure... . uh?
(The moment %s steps forward, the image of Pneuma, which was always full of bright light, becomes blurred.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche, here… . beautiful… K?
(Arke's image is erased without a trace like an eraser, and someone's voice, as if I've heard it before, comes from somewhere.)
“I will allow you to come here. However, you are tied to that child. “Get permission from that child too.”
“Then you will arrive at ▒▒▒▒, where the light has disappeared.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you?
「Mortal. If you don't hurry, the soul of Arche, whom Gaia cherishes, in my hands right now, will be swallowed up... .」
(As soon as those words are finished, the darkness that comes to Pneuma swallows everything in %s.)
(The deep darkness soon disappears, giving %s warm light again. However, the scenery in front of you is not the Pneuma that was just a moment ago.)
(Iris looks at %s's face with a confused and surprised expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris… ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, are you okay with that wound? Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It's okay. When I had time, I tried to meet and tell my story.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: By the way, how did you get here? No one will be able to come in now... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that's right. It's not the time for me to be like this. Iris, help me get there. Pneuma is dangerous.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Stay calm. What does that mean?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sorry… . So, how did that happen?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Iris about receiving Arche's message and visiting Pneuma.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Well, that’s… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: No way. Pneuma is a place where people go to see Gaia, but it is a place where humans are not allowed to go. There's no one on our side.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Even though I haven't been there, I can tell. As the light disappears, I feel lonely, cold and lonely.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: It is a place where gods reside, so a human %s cannot survive for long. Besides, I can't reach that place.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I will do my best for Pneuma. Since this is a place that Gaia has touched, I will be able to do something.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: So… .
(Iris is so surprised by %s's action of holding his hand that he cannot continue speaking.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That god tried to erase Arche right before my eyes. I have to go. Iris, help me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The soul of Arche, whom Gaia cherishes... .
(Iris sighs as if he can't go any further. Then he quietly lets go of %s's hand and steps back.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Phew… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Really, %s… . You are just as stubborn as me. Is this how it felt when Muwen or Zoe stopped me. Phew… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris… ?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I just did it out of frustration. Because it's Arche, I'm allowing it.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Not next time. They will tie me up somewhere, even by force.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, thank you.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Listen carefully.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The name of that place is Elysia... .
(The moment Iris says the name of the place Elysia, the surroundings begin to be filled with dark shadows.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what is it?
「Iris.」
(And in the meantime, the voice of the being who brought the shadow from Pneuma is heard.)
“You, the star god, put Elysia’s name on your lips. “Then take your mortal with you.”
(Dark shadows gradually gather around %s. And unknown ominous spells that seem to have been heard once begin to bother %s's ears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… .
“The black moon will catch you.”
“The black moon will take you.”
“The black moon will catch you. The black moon will take you.”
“The black moon will catch you. The black moon will take you.”
“The black moon will catch you. The black moon will take you away. The black moon will catch you. The black moon will take you.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stop, stop… .
「Welcome. “You mortal.”

steps.name: a place that has lost its light
steps.objective: Defeat [Accurate Anzu] and [Faithful Lesserkula] in “Elysia” and report the quest to [Irfan] on “Road to Elysia”.

lines.text: (An unknown amount of time has passed, and %s's ears, which were struggling in pain, become quiet and all the darkness around them disappears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris? Iris… . Iris? Where are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait a minute, here… .
(A strange sea with a huge moon, a twisted tree floating on the sea, and a cliff with no end in sight. A world full of such heterogeneity is captured in the eyes of Adventurer.)
Come to your senses. Otherwise, you'll fall down here and never come up again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? yes. uh… .
(When I come to my senses and step back, a sturdy man wearing armor slowly walks forward.)
(Long red hair, beard, and armor. An old man, like the hot sun, makes an unidentifiable expression.)
He said he would bring you, but I didn't know he would come, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know me?
I know. First, I would like to apologize to my descendants for their foolishness. What happened in Jude Kingdom was caused by a surge of anger... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it's Jude Kingdom... . Wait a minute. Then you… .
He is said to be Irfan of the Agni clan.
(With Irrfan's introduction, Gigantfall with flames appears and disappears to the side.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Aslan is in the 35th generation and I am in the 6th generation. So much time has passed. There won't be anyone left who remembers me.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Anyway, nice to meet you. It's been a while since I've seen a living person.
(Irrfan extends his hand to shake)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: He still looks like he doesn't know what's going on. I feel uncomfortable with my hands. Could you please shake my hand?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, sorry.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Thank you. I'm glad you're a polite young man.
(Irrfan shakes hands vigorously, looking satisfied.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey Irrfan, I have a question. Where is this place? And you said you were the one who just lived… .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: This is Elysia… .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: It was a place of rest where the ancient gods came to rest. As the people who loved Etoire stayed there, this place was also filled with their light.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: But as they left or disappeared, this place also lost its shine. As you can see, it has become such a cold place now.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: What is it like? This is what Elysia looks like... .
(Irrfan looks at the cliff with flowing water and is lost in thought.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Oh, I almost forgot your question.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Elysia places no restrictions on the gods' visits. However, other beings can come after death. Like me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I died and came here at His call. As his life ended and he closed his eyes among his family, someone held out his hand and held it, and it turned out to be here.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Isn’t there someone you know who has a child in a similar condition to mine? Arche is in Pneuma.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Arche!

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I know he used that child as bait to call you. Because there is something I want from you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whatever you want, you can't do it like this.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: That's okay with him though. Because it's God.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't say such nonsense. Even if he were God, he couldn't do that!!

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I understand your position. But I am a body that does His work. No matter what you say to me, I can’t help it.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: And I will turn a blind eye to making fun of him just this once. If not... .
(When Irrfan stretches out his hand, Gigantfall, which had disappeared behind his back, appears and enters his hand. Then, hidden flames burst out and circle around him.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Even if you were one of Ceres, Gaia, and the new star god, I would turn you into ashes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ugh, it’s such an intimidating feeling….)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: It's up to you.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Will we overcome the trials according to His will, or will we disappear buried in them?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ordeal…. Just like Barbatos….)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Okay, I guess I'll end the nonsense here.
(The Gigantfall in Irrfan's hand turns into flame and disappears.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: First, I want to see what your strength is. Travel around Elysia, deal with beings from other worlds, and then come back.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: It's good for Elysia to meet Etoire again, but it's not good for beings from another world to come.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand. So you're telling me what to do when I come back?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: That's right. I swear in the name of Agni, the sun god, and in the name of Him ▒▒▒.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I still can’t hear that name. I can’t help it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Irrfan, then let’s deal with him properly and come back. Please wait.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Good. Then don't be late.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: ▒▒▒ An uninvited person came in. Shall we watch for a bit first?

steps.name: god's will
steps.objective: Defeat [Di Urta] and [Manun, Bringer of Death] in “Elysia” and report the quest to [Irfan] in “Elysia 2”.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Good job!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now tell me what I should do.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You have an impatient personality. I already tried to tell you.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Even if it were a minor god from another world, it wouldn't have been easy to deal with... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: They are the ones who were personally opened and called here by ▒▒▒, the owner of Elysia.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Each person may have been a god in their own world, but from the moment they crossed the gate and came here, they became beings who had to follow his will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why should I fight them?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: That's their job. I only accepted the deal because there was a purpose. It is beyond the understanding of mortals like you and me.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Accept it as God's will.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Since you have come here, do not go against his will. Because all you can do here is overcome your trials.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: If you act with foolish thoughts, the worst moment you can think of will come.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even if you say it's God's will, the fact that they're threatening you doesn't change.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Hehe… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then we will live up to your expectations. They say that's the only thing they can do anyway.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You… , You’re overflowing with unnecessary spirit.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Now, follow me.

steps.name: first trial
steps.objective: Defeat [Anshara] in 「Black Moon Trial」 and obtain <Piece of Joy of Trial>. Then report the quest to [Irfan] in 「Elysia 2」.

lines.text: (On one side of Elysia, a moon-shaped stone is shining brightly in the distance, embedded in a large rock.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: On the left is the Trial of the Black Moon, and on the right is the Trial of the Earth. First, go into the trials of the Black Moon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do I get in?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: If you stand in front of the moon-shaped rock and stretch out your hand, Elysia's power will guide you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I understand.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Why do you do that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (No matter what you say to someone who doesn't have common sense anyway, it'll be the same.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Once again, first is the Black Moon Trial.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please wait here. I'll finish it soon and come back.
(Irrfan glances at the back of %s passing by him.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: What a fun friend. To believe that all gods are the same... .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: The uninvited guests are those friends. Of course, those smelly beasts... .
(The moment %s's hand touches the moon-shaped rock, a shadow appears from somewhere and leads to a new place.)
(Unlike the warmth you feel at the end of the ground where you step, the endless universe behind you seems colder than any other place.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this where the ordeal begins... . It's a huge feeling of discomfort. But that… .
(Two people who seem to have been waiting for the subject of the ordeal can be seen from a distance. One of them waves his hand warmly and says hello.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Welcome, %s. What do you think is your ordeal created by ▒▒▒?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Kazno, I don't like being in someone else's ordeal, but I have no choice but to finish what I'm doing.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: You talked about it last time, so I'll talk about it this time.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Got it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But… , last time?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: I don't think I remember. I can't help it. ▒▒▒ must have been very angry at me for making you like this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know when, but one thing I know for sure is that I'm here because of God... .So whether you remember it or not, it will be the same.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: You have changed a lot in the meantime... . What if you were destined like us? Suddenly I'm curious.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Stop it.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: I was going to stop at this point.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what is the story you want to tell?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Ouroboros, born from a misinterpretation of Iris's will.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Ouroboros is trying to turn the world into nothingness. This has nothing to do with what witches and demons do.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: So we are looking for traces of Ouroboros.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why does Agashura seek Ouroboros?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: We don't want this world to disappear either. Because there are things that require this world to exist.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: It may be contradictory, but that's how we were born. You know. That I am a sinner.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: So we did our own thing and found work for Iris.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Among superhumans, I made a deal with Shinik, who knew the traces of Ouroboros.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: I pledged my life and Kazno's life as collateral to get their cooperation to free me from the curse, and I chased away the snake shadow that was Ouroboros' alter ego.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: What happened with the snake shadow is the same as you know.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: I tried to sign a contract to lift Shinik's curse, but he actually refused. I don't want to be involved with being a criminal again because it's no fun.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: They say that, but for Shineek, it seems like the culprit that made him like that has disappeared.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: There's nothing wrong with the contract, but if someone messes with Perse's power, Shinik could run wild.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shinik will be fine.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Well, Shinik is Shinik. After that incident, our pursuit of Ouroboros became easier. I also found a bait to summon Ouroboros.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: They're waiting for the moment when Ouroboros shows up to take the bait. The problem is that the bait keeps running away. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is that bait?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: I can't tell you that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So can you answer this? How did you get to Elysia?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Should I say Kazno and my will? Hehe, I hope I get the answer.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Let's go now. We must do what we can.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you going to look for that bait?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Let’s put it that way.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: %s, solve your ordeal right away. So I'll see you again later.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Goodbye for today.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: I’ll just go… .
(As soon as Jeril and Kazno finish speaking, they run towards an unknown destination in the deepening darkness.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's the purpose of those two... . Hehe, once Ouroboros is captured, Iris will have less to worry about.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, this is not the time to be like this.
(The darkness in front of me grows bigger and bigger, as if it is going to eat what I see in the ordeal.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's an ordeal made for me... . Phew, I don't know. Let's go first.
(At the dead end where you defeat the approaching beings from another world one by one, %s appears in front of you as if it had been waiting for you.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .
(Seeing %s's appearance, the black being steps forward and slams the weapon he was holding on the floor.)
Boom!
(After a while, the world begins to shake, as if an earthquake has occurred.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rabbit?
(To say it's a rabbit, it walks like a human, has a large body, and holds a large hammer in its hands with golden gauntlets... Such a being looks at Adventurer with a strange feeling.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're a rabbit, but you don't like being called a rabbit?
(The Black Rabbit nods his head.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ansha… ? Anshara?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that your name? Did you say hello just now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wait... that thing isn't saying anything... why does it seem like it's making noise?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what do you want to do here?
(Anshara frowns and raises a two-handed hammer to %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it? Ruthless?
(Anshara nods without saying anything.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: God from another world? I made a contract with the owner of this place, and even though it's not what you want, you're going to step on me according to the terms of the contract?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And he was angry that I dared to show this attitude to God? But, I can't help it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Because I have to do what I have to do. uh?
(At that moment, a powerful wave of power passes through %s's face.)
(After a while, %s's cheek is torn, and blood begins to flow from it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now is the start?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't know they would declare war like this, but it can't be helped. I will end this ordeal somehow.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wasn’t that what you wanted anyway? Anshara?
(As soon as Anshara's eyes meet, Anshara rushes at high speed with a hammer in hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then let's do it. At least there is a God behind me who is more trustworthy than you.
(Anshara falls down after receiving a direct hit from %s.)
(Anshara stands up once again, but loses the golden hammer she was holding as the gauntlet is destroyed.)
(And then it sits down and seems to have lost its strength, slowly losing its light.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I guess it was unfair to be defeated by a person who ignored me... . Even though it fell down, it was so loud... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ha, ha... . it's hard… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I’m dizzy….)
(The ominous shadow encroaching on the surroundings swallows up what was Anshara just moments ago.)
(Then the voice of the person who created the ordeal flows from the shadows.)
「Mortal. Even if he was a minor god from another world, he would not have been an easy opponent.”
“Thanks to you, Anshara’s power became Elysia’s power. “I express my gratitude for this.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: God from another world was used as nourishment for this place... .
“Are you curious?”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's it. I don't want to hear it. I will finish the next trial, so let's return Arche and Pneuma to their original state.
“You’re confident.”
“I originally had no intention of touching Pneuma, but I was curious about your reaction. “Because you, a mortal, are more interesting than you think.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's been a while since I heard something interesting.
“I will give it back to you if you solve all the hardships. That child and Pneuma. Then prove yourself in the next trial. “You mortal.”
(After the warning left by the ominous god, the shadow disappears. And through it, a path that appears to lead outside is visible.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a road leading to trials... . I have no choice but to go first... .

steps.name: Elysia's owner
steps.objective: Meet the being invited in “The Nameless Place,” then return to “Elysia 2” and report the quest to [Irfan].

lines.text: (Irfan, who had his eyes closed, looks forward as if he felt something. He smiles slightly as Adventurer slowly walks out from behind the moon-shaped tombstone.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Hey, you look like you're having a hard time. Still, I'm glad I came back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I solved it, but... .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I understand you're angry. I know that what I say makes you even more angry. Still, let’s keep quiet and move on to the next ordeal… .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You must have met the beasts waiting for you inside, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Beasts? I don't know who you are talking about. I met a rabbit pretending to be a god... .
(The flames from Irrfan's gigantol begin to swirl beneath %s's feet.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Please answer me properly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Agashura, two.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: What is your relationship with you, and what did you talk about?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He said he just met him once in a while and that he was looking for something.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I understand.
(As Irrfan nods, the flame under %s's feet disappears without a trace.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: It must be important to see uninvited beasts looking for something. They probably know it too.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: As this is what those born from the contradictions of the world do... .
(While Irrfan was smoothing his beard, Elysia suddenly started shaking.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what is it?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: It looks like other uninvited guests have appeared besides the beasts.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aren't uninvited beings unable to come to Elysia?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: That's right. haha. Aren't you curious about what's happening here now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Then, go to the empty space on one side of Elysia. You will soon find out how your relationships are intertwined.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is that... .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Please leave quietly.
(Irrfan quietly looks at %s's back as he walks away with a dissatisfied expression.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You've changed your mind... . What are you going to do next?
(The moment you enter the path that appears while exploring Elysia, thick darkness spreads around %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As if I was waiting... What should I do? This is definitely...)
(As the darkness around %s, who was examining the situation for a moment, recedes slightly, someone's bare feet are visible.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you?
(The darkness gradually disperses, revealing the hidden beings little by little.)
(At the center of a world that has lost its light, a woman shining like a moon embracing darkness stares expressionlessly at the face of %s.)
Are you curious about my name?
Mortal... .
If you want to know, I'll tell you.
(The woman reaches out and touches %s's frozen face.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ooh, I can't move... This feeling of intimidation... Huh?)
(At that moment, someone’s name flows into %s’s mind.)
Mortal. Say my name that is floating in your head.
I asked who I am, the master of those who wait for the black moon, death, and night.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Heh… .
Come on… !

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Heh… Kate… .
(When the name Hecate comes out of %s's mouth, the woman smiles as if satisfied. Then, she grabs the neck of the mortal human and throws it away.)
Boom.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: No wonder Anshara got angry when she saw your attitude.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Now, wake up. Mortal.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, uh… .
(Hecate approaches %s, who struggles to get up, and holds out her hand. But the mortal, foolish in Hecate's eyes, shakes the hand away.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need those hands... no… .

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: I understand what you mean. Then I change my judgment too.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: My world... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This is….)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: The fog of death rising from the black moon that covers the earth.
(The black shadow that disappeared around Hecate blooms again.)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: The soul that the primordial darkness will devour is here, so grab it and take it with you… , in the name of Hecate… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Well, I have to run away. I’m here….)
(The shadow turns into a snake and approaches %s and begins to strangle him.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can't die here...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can't die...)
(Like the universe in the beginning where there was no world that lost light, even the small world of %s is immersed in deep darkness.)
Come to your senses!!
(Someone shouts out to %s who was stuck in the dark and could do nothing.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … who?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do we get here… .
(As the thick darkness disperses a little, Hilda is seen holding Hecate's wrist.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda… .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I came to my senses. Come on, run away!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: My feet can't move... .

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: I’m surprised you came this far, Hilda.
(Hecate frowns when she sees Hilda holding her hand.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: If you're going to joke around, do it in moderation, Hecate.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: You came all the way here and dared to call the owner’s name in vain… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hilda moves like nothing happens? I still can't move my feet...)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Hilda.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Let go of this hand. I won't say it twice.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: You know it too. What you are doing now is a foolish decision.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I want to live. Let this person go.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: If you had come this far, you would have needed determination. Just for that reason... .
(Hecate shakes off Hilda’s hand and steps back.)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Hilda, this is my world, Elysia. What do you think you can do here?

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: It is my will that the child loved by Gaia and Ceres, the mortal he cares about, die here.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: As a witch, you also know that you can die here... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I have to live, get out of here….)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: God knows one thing and doesn’t know two… . Like the night chasers, you are the one who shaped my destiny. but… .

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Do you really think I don’t know?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: If Ouroboros appears, the world you want is... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ouroboros... ?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Anyway, let this guy go. The rest I... .

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Let's make a deal? That's not how trading works. first… .
(As Hecate quietly gazes at a place, a path hidden in the darkness is revealed. And a boy is seen in the gap.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: This is embarrassing... . I never thought I would encounter the God of the Black Moon.
(Jeril walks out slowly, scratching his cheek slightly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why is Jeril there? .

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: %s, did you forget what I told you earlier? I told you we had our own work to do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What to do? What on earth are you going to do... .
(Jeril passes Hecate as if nothing had happened and approaches %s's side to check her condition.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: It's been a while since Adventurer was so scared that I couldn't move. haha. Even if I wanted to save you, it would be difficult.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Hilda, it’s been a while. There's no need to be scared. I'll pick you up soon, so just wait.
(At that time, a black vine rises from Hecate's feet and flies towards Jeril at high speed.)
(However, the approaching black vine stops as the beast's roar rings out on the spot. Then, it withers and disappears into the shadows.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: God of the Black Moon. Didn't you think of me too easily?

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: There is nothing to say to animals.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: When the world is in danger, the subject is helplessly trapped... . The Black Moon God is as arrogant and foolish as Lethe. How long are you going to be like that?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Don't disturb me.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Oh, I'm dizzy... .
(Hilda, who was observing the situation, seems to have lost strength in her legs and sits down.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda? Hilda, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Joe, stay back a little. Oh, I'm dizzy... .

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Is that so... .
(Hecate smiles as if she knew something from Hilda's struggling appearance.)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: I see. I think I now understand why you want to live.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: %s, let me tell you a truth. You and Hilda... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Stop!!
(Hilda shouts out loud, and the place where everyone is begins to shake slightly.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Hecate, stop it!!

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Wait a minute, Hilda. If I do this now... … … .
(The spear of green light that wasn't there before escapes from Hilda's hand and heads toward Hecate's neck.)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: How far will a being powered by the power of the Black Moon go in defiance?!

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Swallow it all up.
(With Hecate's angry voice, the world is filled with shadows again. It's as if everyone who was in front of her just moments ago has been erased.)
(As the shadow retreats little by little, Elysia's appearance returns to the way it was when she first stepped forward.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There is no one… .
(Hilda and Jeril, who had been arguing with Hecate just a moment ago, are nowhere to be seen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where have you gone? What on earth did Hecate do? . Ah, my body seems to be moving again... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?
(Irrfan, who had been near the Gate of Trials for some time, appears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Irfan.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Hecate left “for now.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For now?)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I'm very surprised. Okay, for now.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I don't know what Hecate means, but she said she would give you one more chance... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Opportunity?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Try the remaining trials. Because the earth's trials still remain.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He suddenly appeared and tried to kill me... , Another chance?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Opportunities like this are rare, so be grateful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Maybe we should think of this as an opportunity and accept it... Because beings like Barbatos, Lethe, and Hecate have different ways of thinking.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Rest here for a bit, and when you're ready, return to the location where the Gate of Trials is.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Because it takes some time to move after being crushed by the power of God.
(Irrfan delivers all the words he has prepared and returns to the location where the entrance to the ordeal was.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He spoke as if he had experienced it and then disappeared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't help it. Since this isn't a familiar place, I have no choice but to do as I'm told... .

steps.name: second ordeal
steps.objective: Defeat [Kishara] in “Ordeal of the Earth” and obtain <Sorrow Fragment of Ordeal>. Then report the quest to [Irfan] in 「Elysia 2」.

lines.text: (Irfan, who was thinking about something with his eyes closed, opens his eyes at the sight of %s approaching.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As you said, I took a rest.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Maybe it's because I received God's protection, but it seems like I'm recovering quickly from Elysia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I feel lighter, but I don't think that's the case...)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Now, look to the right.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: All you have to do is stand in front of the moon-shaped rock and stretch out your hand, just like you did during the Black Moon Trial.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: The place of trial will guide you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will overcome this time and come back.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You are confident. Then come back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I… , Irrfan.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Why but?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If I solve all of these trials, will everything I can do in Elysia end?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Hmm.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: It's not my trial, so I can't give you a definite answer. Still, Hecate will keep her promise.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Of course, you may change your mind midway... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, it's just a whim.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Heh heh. I've never met anyone like you who treats God like you. Even though I warned you so... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Since I'm talking to myself, pretend you didn't hear it. Then I will come back.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: The ordeal may not be fun, but I wish you luck.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It was a cheer I didn’t really want to hear.)
(The moment you touch the moon-shaped rock, a shadow appears from somewhere and takes you to a new place.)
(A human face carved into a huge rock on a lonely hill is looking down, and between the hills there are full of sharp thorn bushes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's breathtaking... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Get your shit together, %s. This is no ordinary place... . But why is the road like this?
(A sharp plant stem is placed on a path made of sharp stone pieces.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you preparing for something like this? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I made eye contact with that rock face in an unpleasant way. Are you listening? Phew. Then let me just say something.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You said you would keep your promise, so I will trust you. then… .
(It was an unwanted ordeal, but I accepted it and after a long time of wandering around looking for a way, I reached the end of a dead end.)
(In the distance, a torch burning as red as the flame of Agni is erected.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What should I do here now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .
(The moment you take a step, you see a stone statue of a woman standing at the end.)
(The sight of three women who look like they are shedding tears of blood, holding a torch, a key, and a dagger, gives an emotion that goes beyond the bizarre.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this... .
(The moment you approach the statue, it rattles as if shaken by the wind.)
(The statue's pupils widen, and its tightly closed mouth opens. The sound coming from the mouth flows into %s's ears and begins to wander in his head.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, stop… . Wait, what? What are you saying now?
(Just as when meeting Anshara, the statue's message naturally begins to spread in %s's mind.)
“You came to kill me too.”
“Don’t kill Kishara.”
“Do you know how difficult it is to come back from death!!”
(Every time the stone statue that introduces itself as Kishara speaks, unknown pain and fear pours down on %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I need to cover my ears. Anything that can block it... uh, this...)
(Adventurer is startled by the orange ribbon coming out of his pocket, but quickly cuts the ribbon and covers his ears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … It seems to be getting better now. Phew… .
(Kishara moves little by little as she continues spewing out unintelligible words.)

lines.speaker: 키샤라
lines.text: “I never want to die again.”

lines.speaker: 키샤라
lines.text: “Can Hecate save Kishara?”

lines.speaker: 키샤라
lines.text: “You have the arrogance to not kneel even when you see God. 」
(Kishara, who was talking as if two different personalities were talking, suddenly raises a key, a torch, and a dagger.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No way… .
(The goals set by the different Kisharas were the same, so they all shouted the same words.)

lines.speaker: 키샤라
lines.text: 『I will kill you right here!!』
(With a large impact, fragments fly out of Kishara's body and hit the floor.)
Boom!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ha, ha... .
(The head of the statue splits little by little, then loses its balance and falls to the floor.)
(As the unbalanced statue splits apart, Kishara, who had been quiet until a moment ago, opens her mouth and starts talking.)

lines.speaker: 키샤라
lines.text: “I got a chance to come back to life... .」

lines.speaker: 키샤라
lines.text: “I couldn’t live in this body from the beginning.”

lines.speaker: 키샤라
lines.text: “Hecate just used Kishara.”

lines.speaker: 키샤라
lines.text: 『It’s over anyway.』

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have no complaints with you. But, I have to finish the ordeal.

lines.speaker: 키샤라
lines.text: “I already knew. The end of the God who ran away... .」

lines.speaker: 키샤라
lines.text: “There was no place to come back.”

lines.speaker: 키샤라
lines.text: “The fact that the things someone was singing about have disappeared… .」

lines.speaker: 키샤라
lines.text: 『I didn't mean to hold Hecate's hand. The thing that imprisoned Hecate was... , What Hecate imprisoned... .』

lines.speaker: 키샤라
lines.text: 『Kaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa… .』
(Kishara, who was pouring out unknown words, stands up again with a strange groan. Then, with those words, Kishara, who had fallen down, stands up again.)

lines.speaker: 키샤라
lines.text: 『We, Kishara, cannot fall like this. Die!!』
(Before Kishara's attack can reach, %s's attack enters the broken gap first.)

lines.speaker: 키샤라
lines.text: 『Hecate, as you said, I thought it would be okay to take the soul that awoke after being buried for eternity... … … … .』

lines.speaker: 키샤라
lines.text: 『Kwaaaaaa… , Kwaaaa!!』
(Kishara's mouth closes with a bizarre scream, and the destroyed area cracks more and more.)
(And with a loud roar, the stone statue that was Kishara a moment ago turns into powder and scatters in the space that was the ordeal.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As I see it getting darker, I wonder if it is slowly appearing... . what… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hecate, your trials are over. Come out now and keep your promise!!
(As the shadow rising from the ordeal is coloring everything, Hecate slowly walks out from somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: You did it again this time. Kishara's power would also have been a source of nourishment for Elysia.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: There was no place to put it, so I put it in a stone statue that resembled me, and it seems to have tied Kishara's feet.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: I had unreasonable hopes.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: I praise you for overcoming your ordeal. Well done. Mortal.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't want to be praised, so get your hands off Arche, Hilda, and Pneuma.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: I really don't like you, the person those kids care about.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: You know that God's voice is never light. okay. I'll give it back.
(With Hecate's words, the surrounding shadows gradually recede and Hilda is seen lying underneath them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda!!
(Hecate sneers as she sees %s hurriedly approaching Hilda and supporting her.)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Thanks to you, it was fun. Mortal. Take Hilda and go back.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: From the moment Hilda wakes up, you will have to make a choice. Should we destroy Hilda's soul and take it as is? Or maybe your spirit will break and you will be killed by Hilda.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … What does that mean?

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Neither you nor Hilda would have wanted it, but the soul was already born into that fate. There is nothing I can do for you except lead your soul that the old man touched to death.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This doesn't make sense. I can't do that. I am me... .

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Such ridiculous things happen to gods like me, so it wouldn't be surprising if they happened to you %s. Your soul is no longer yours alone.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: You know that too, right?

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: At various points in time, you appeared in different forms and died.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Hehehe.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Iris, there will be limits to what that child can do to fix your curse. It wouldn't be a bad thing to be cursed and become a sinner.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: No matter how hard you try not to die, the result is the same. Mortal. The only difference is who gets killed.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Didn’t even the gods associated with Etoire die…? .

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Hehe, don't be scared. There are still a lot of fun things left.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Children who have become witches chasing the night with my power. Watch what they will do, mortal. Having to talk like this makes me feel sorry for the sleeping Gaia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hecate!!
(Hecate frowns as if she doesn't like her name being called.)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Today is the last time I will tolerate your rudeness. Then, mortal. Please stay alive until we meet again.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: And Iris too… .
(Hecate hides herself in the dark shadow as she says her final greeting. After a while, the shadow that filled the space disappears at a rapid pace.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hecate, stand there!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Damn… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why am I like that... .

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Ugh… , eww… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey Hilda, are you out of your mind?
(Hilda, unable to open her eyes, calls %s's name and loses consciousness again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda? Come to your senses. spirit… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Kazno? Oh, that's right. Jeryl… .

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Jeril doesn't have to worry. You should immediately check the spirit world. This witch is me... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stop. I know that Hilda is a bait to call Ouroboros. So you want to take me?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: I have no intention of doing so now. First of all, if you go to Iris, you can buy this witch now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If that's the case, I should take it with me.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: %s!! Come to your senses!! Now listen to me!!

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Listen to me, if only for your own sake and for Iris’s sake!!

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: The moment Hilda opens her eyes and sees you, someone will die. therefore… .

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: If you don't want to face the worst moment with your own hands, leave it to me for now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay… .
(Kazno looks at %s's face as she answers with resignation and then supports Hilda.)

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Talk to Iris later. What will happen to this witch? And I won't touch Hilda for the time being... .
(As soon as Kazno supports Hilda, he disappears in place.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's gone... . how… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda came back, but still... . Is pneuma okay? Arche is... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have to go and ask Irfan... .

steps.name: overcome the ordeal
steps.objective: After talking to [Irfan] in 「Elysia 2」, report the quest to [Irfan] in 「Road to Elysia」.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Good job! I thought this ordeal from Hecate was harsh, but looking at your expression... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Irrfan, Pneuma is... .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Hecate has restored it to its original state, so there is no need to worry.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: After all, you don't believe in him. Originally, the existence of a god would be similar to Hecate.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Maybe it's because the gods you served didn't show their majesty... .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Phew. That's okay, follow me. That's where you first saw me.

steps.name: a soul that can't rest
steps.objective: After talking with [Irfan] in “Road to Elysia,” report the quest to [Arke] in “Pneuma.”

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Now you are free to come to Elysia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Hecate has given permission for you to enter. From now on, follow the path of Pneuma and come here.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: And he said that he would leave the place of trial as is. He also said that if you want to become stronger, it wouldn't be a bad idea to experience the same trials over and over again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: To go through a difficult ordeal again... .

lines.speaker: 이르판
