lines.text: Because you do not properly accept God's will, God gave you consideration to set you free.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, consideration… .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Now, go back. Once you've checked the pneuma, go back and say hello to Iris.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Come on.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm going to go back... but what does it feel like to be urged...)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Oh, next time I come, I'll ask for desert sand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You seem confident that I will come back... .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Someday I'll need a story from my past. Even if that's not the case, Hecate looks forward to meeting you.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: If you follow the circular light you see over there, you can go to Pneuma.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then let's go. See you later, Irrfan.
(%s disappears and Hecate approaches Irrfan, who was standing still.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Are you okay, Hecate?

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: You, a mortal, ask for the safety of a god. Heh… . It seems okay.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I’m sorry… .

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: If not, it would not be true, and if so, it could also be said to be so. In my current situation, all I can say is this much.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Okay. By the way, weren’t you planning on coming down?

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Agashura has left, and now there are guests coming to Elysia, where it's just you and me... . Of course, I didn't invite this guest either... .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Black butterfly... .

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: You have arrived.
(A black butterfly flies from somewhere and falls to the ground, losing its light. A man slowly walks over and tramples the black butterfly.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Maybe it's because it's been a while, but it feels very unfamiliar. ah… .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: It's been a while since I saw the owner of the Black Moon. I didn't know you would come out to meet me in person.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: I can't believe I found my way here. To what extent has it come back?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Haha, not yet.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Even though you wore the shell of a demon, you survived for a long time. Why did you come to Elysia, living around with the dirty demons and demons of Pandemonium?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Didn't the God of the Black Moon disappear just like other gods, and didn't spend time imprisoned?

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: A dirty demon is using his mouth carelessly.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Doing dirty work is the same for everyone... .
(Barvatos raises the weapon in his hand and aims it at Hecate. A boy who followed Barbatos is surprised by the current situation and hurries to hide behind Irfan.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: What, what? The Archduke asked to come here, but as soon as he saw that person, he gave a clear indication that they were not on good terms with him.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Is that person... .

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Did the Grand Duke say he would introduce you to Hecate?

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: No, I told you to follow me if you don't want to die. By the way, grandpa. Who on earth is that woman?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: What a rude kid.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Just watch. There is no room for people like us to intervene... .

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Yeah?
(Hecate quietly pushes Barbatos' great sword away with her fingertips.)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Grand Duke, I have no reason to fight with you.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Since you woke up and became involved in the world, didn't you prepare for death?

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Is that what happens to the Archduke? It's meaningless to me anyway.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: So the Grand Duke… .

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: How many gods have you killed so far?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Hehe, I don’t know. Please ask something else than that. I will only answer one question.
(Barbatos puts away his great sword and adjusts his glasses.)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Is that so?

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: You had ample time to cut down Gaia in Sanctuary. But, I didn't do that.
(A deep shadow falls on Barbatos' face as he listens to Hecate.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: If I cut you here, would that answer some of your questions?

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Hehehe. Grand Duke, you don’t have to answer if you don’t want to. I just wanted to see what your reaction was.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Now, I have a suggestion for you... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I will listen and decide what to do.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: It will suit your taste as you climb out of the abyss of despair. Then let the story begin.
(Arke, who looks anxious, sees %s and rushes over.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Well, I think it's okay. Because Pneuma and the spirits have returned to their original state... . It’s okay… .
(Arke collapses as his legs seem to have lost their strength. The surprised Adventurer hurries to get up, but Arche's trembling does not stop.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche… , it’s not okay at all… .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I'm scared.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I never thought I would feel this way again after coming to Pneuma... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It feels like that time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: At that time... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: When my soul failed to merge and fell apart, I felt fear. Even when I was reborn, I didn't have that fear... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Obviously, Pneuma returned to its original form as if nothing had happened... Just because there was a door connected to Elysia... .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I, I… . It’s painful because things I don’t want to think about keep coming back to me… .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I shouldn’t do this even for Gaia’s sake… .
(As if trying to soothe Arche's anxious feelings, several Atmos approach and hover around her.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Thanks, guys… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you calmed down?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Yes… . Just a little bit. sorry. To see %s, who worked so hard for Pneuma, like this... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. Arche, get some rest.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll go to Iris. Uh, Arche?
(Arke holds %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: You can't go now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Before %s returned, Iris had something to say to me through the spirit.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what did Iris say?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: The person named Hilda that %s rescued is okay. And don't come looking for me until the time is right.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Maybe… .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: That's probably because they are beings with similar colored souls... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If that's the case, there's nothing we can do... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then what should I do...? I guess we have no choice but to wait...)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: %s, don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's how it should be. But, Arche… .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hecate just told me that we are destined to hurt each other's souls. What does it mean to be similar souls?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did Arche know what happens when similar souls meet?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: That’s… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it really a secret?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It's not a secret. Even if I say it with my own mouth, %s won't hear it properly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That’s right. No matter how much you hear from other people’s mouths, you can’t hear it unless God allows it….)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Iris Because you now know what the Black Moon God said... . sorry. Because I can't help you... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay. Then I'll have to wait until Iris is called.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, Arche… . Can I take a break at Pneuma for a while?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Yes, of course. You can stay as long as you want.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ever since the witch appeared, my mind has been so complicated... … .

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I'll lend you Aerura.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you… .
(Several Aeruras roaming the Pneuma sky approach %s, fluttering feathers and petals.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I thought meeting Iris and helping Iris was what I had to do... but that wasn't the only thing...)
(The moment I lean against Aerura, who came to me as if to console my complicated feelings, the anxiety I felt just now disappears.)
(I fall into such a deep sleep that I never want to wake up again.)
